subject: [PATCH v4 6/8] mm: zswap: Store large folios in batches.

reviews.author: Kanchana Sridhar
reviews.summary: Reviewer Kanchana Sridhar expressed concerns that using SLUB would make compressed memory unmovable and requested a discussion of the trade-off between migration and representing it as unmovable memory
reviews.raw_body:
Yes, SLUB comes with the constraint of the compressed memory being
unmovable. However, I want to better understand the trade off between
compressed memory migration vs. potentially representing it as SLUB
unmovable memory that needs to be written back. I was hoping to
include a discussion of my understanding of the pros-and-cons when I
submit this RFC, to get your thoughts.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: The patch optimizes zswap by batching the compression of large memory pages, reducing overhead and improving performance.
